# netbox_config_templates (Data Source)

Lists config_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_config_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-config_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `config_templates` (Attributes List) The matching config_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--config_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_templates`

Read-Only:

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Serve the rendered output as a download.
- `created` (String)
- `debug` (Boolean) Render with Jinja2 debugging enabled.
- `description` (String)
- `environment_params` (String) Parameters for the Jinja2 environment, as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `file_extension` (String) File extension of the rendered output.
- `file_name` (String) File name of the rendered output.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type of the rendered output.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `template_code` (String) Jinja2 template code.
- `url` (String)
